profile_text.body:
Sinovation Ventures is a Chinese technology venture capital firm, according to its own website. The firm describes itself as leading in that category and says it was founded in 2009 by a team led by Dr. Kai-Fu Lee. Its site states that it manages ten USD- and RMB-denominated funds with over US$3 billion in assets under management, and that it has backed more than 500 portfolio companies across technology and innovation globally.

The firm is recorded as for-profit and headquartered in Beijing, China. No AI products, lawsuits, or other filings are held for it.
